part.text:
All tests pass. Summary of the fix:

- **`XYPoint.equals`** (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/XYPoint.java:68): changed `point.x == x && point.y == y` to `Float.compare(...)` comparisons, so `-0.0` vs `0.0` (which have different hash codes) are correctly treated as unequal.
- **`XYCircle.equals`** (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/XYCircle.java:81): same change for `x`, `y`, and `radius`.
- **`Rectangle2D.equals`** (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/Rectangle2D.java:262): same latent contract violation with its `Double.hashCode`-based `hashCode`; switched to `Double.compare`.

`XYRectangle` already used `Float.compare`, and `XYLine`/`XYPolygon` use `Arrays.equals`, which already has bit-comparison semantics. Verified with the reproduction seed (`-Dtests.seed=3ABEFE4D876DD310 -Dtests.nightly=true`) — `TestXYPoint`, `TestXYRectangle`, `TestXYCircle`, and `TestRectangle2D` all pass (20/20), and the full `org.apache.lucene.geo` test package passes as well.
